pages.text: Show why a railway needs traffic control.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use a native block or chain signal on a valid shared route. A real native occupied/conflicting section must produce the stop and later release.

pages.title: How to use it
pages.text: Bind signals to track positions and select their mode with a wrench. Control scheduled train entry into occupied sections and busy junctions.
